description: Paid ($0.005 USDC on Base, x402). Fetch a web page as text, with a signed record of what was served and when. Returns the page's readable text plus an Ed25519-signed record (final URL after redirects, fetch time, status, sha256 of the body and of the text) that verifies offline. Charged only for 2xx text pages; refused URLs cost nothing.. Charged only if it succeeds. Call once without payment to get the price, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].

max_chars.description: Most characters of text to return (default 50000); the signature covers exactly what is returned
